messages.subject: Re: Q3 proposal
messages.snippet: Thanks for sending this over — the breakdown looks good. Can you confirm the beta date before Friday?
messages.body:
Hi,

Thanks for sending the Q3 proposal over — the breakdown looks good on our side.

Two things before we sign:

1. Can you confirm the beta review date before Friday?
2. Legal asked whether the 30-day support window starts at launch or at beta.

If both check out we're ready to move.

Best,
Amira
Acme Co.
